;Disasters and accidents
*[[Ural Airlines Flight 178]]
**A [[Ural Airlines]] [[Airbus 321]] crash lands in a field near [[Zhukovsky International Airport]] in [[Moscow Region]], [[Russia]]. The event is dubbed the "Miracle over [[Ramensk]]", as only 23 passengers had minor injuries, similar to [[US Airways Flight 1549]]. Preliminary reports say the aircraft struck a flock of [[seagulls]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/15/europe/russia-plane-crash-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[Cessna Citation family|Cessna Citation]] carrying former [[NASCAR]] driver [[Dale Earnhardt Jr.]], his wife and infant daughter crashes on landing at [[Elizabethton Municipal Airport]] in [[Elizabethton, Tennessee]]. All occupants survive without serious injury. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/15/us/dale-earnhardt-jr-plane-incident/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Colombia&ndash;Venezuela relations]]
**[[Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] gives a speech wherein he accuses former [[Colombian President]] [[Álvaro Uribe]], Uribe's Vice President [[Francisco Santos Calderón]], and Venezuelan politician {{ill|Lester Toledo|es}} of planning to kill him. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-colombia/venezuelas-maduro-accuses-former-colombian-president-uribe-of-plotting-to-kill-him-idUSKCN1V505Q (Reuters)]
*[[Iran&ndash;United Kingdom relations]]; [[Iran&ndash;United States relations]]
**[[Gibraltar]] says the [[United States]] has applied to seize the [[Iran]]ian [[oil tanker]] ''[[Grace 1]]'', which is being held by the [[United Kingdom]] territory for an alleged breach of [[European Union]] sanctions against [[Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN1V50WQ (Reuters)]
**The UK releases ''Grace 1'' back to Iran after receiving written assurance that the oil would not be sent to Syria. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-49362182 (BBC News)]
*[[Israel&ndash;United States relations]] 
**Two American [[Islam in the United States|Muslim]] [[congresswomen]], [[Ilhan Omar]] and [[Rashida Tlaib]], are barred from entering [[Israel]] before a planned visit to the country due to their support of the [[Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions|BDS]] movement, a decision which was encouraged by [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/08/15/politics/israel-visit-ilhan-omar-rashida-tlaib-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Proposed United States purchase of Greenland]]
**Press sources report that [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] repeatedly expressed interest in buying [[Greenland]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/trump-eyes-a-new-real-estate-purchase-greenland-11565904223 (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://apnews.com/65a521dc605e43bd972ba6fcf36a5713 (AP News)]
